column1: # Burnside fixed points: Fix(g) = number of maximal placements left unchanged by symmetry g (1..7; 0 = identity).
# classes = (total + sum Fix) / 8. Source files: one search per (k, n, g) in symmetric mode (Q3_SYM=g).
# g = 1: rotate 90, 2: rotate 180, 3: rotate 270, 4: mirror left-right, 5: mirror top-bottom, 6: transpose, 7: anti-transpose.
